roads.name: Pebbly Beach Road
words: Curve after curve after curve: 22 in 2.3 miles, about 10 a mile.
Plenty of tight curves among them.
From 2 to 143 ft, with 566 ft of up and down along the way.
Water alongside for stretches.
Homes line much of it: about 45 buildings a mile beside the road.
27 parks, trailheads and other stops along it, so it's likely busier than most, especially on weekends.
July highs average 79°F.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 20 mph limit its curves ask for about 0.17 g.

From 185 to 1,399 ft, with 1,465 ft of up and down along the way.
July highs average 78°F.
